_comment: I0 provider playbook (schema: app/domain/playbook.py). Public facts only, every claim sourced. KuCoin's Information Request System is for authorised law enforcement with proof of authority and a government-domain e-mail; requests are in English, signed or sealed (a digital signature / seal is refused), state the freeze duration (otherwise the account is unfrozen within 30 days of the freeze) and whether the user may be told. KuCoin EU (Austria) is a separate entity with its own LE inbox. Victims open a support ticket; KuCoin has reportedly required a formal LE case number before freezing.
notes: If a request is not clearly addressed to one KuCoin entity, list the possible entities. Cross-border requests attach the MLAT documents. Mark urgent requests 'URGENT REQUEST' in the subject. Identifiers (name, e-mail, phone, UID, TxIDs, addresses) go in copiable text (PDF, Word, Excel or the e-mail body), never as images only. The KuCoin EU LE inbox is not catalogued (each address needs its own review).

entities.name: KuCoin EU Exchange GmbH (KuCoin EU, MiCA CASP)
entities.notes: Authorised by the Austrian FMA under MiCA (Nov 2025); serves EEA residents except Malta. A reported 2026 restriction on its operations is unconfirmed.

sibling.purpose: KuCoin EU: law-enforcement requests by e-mail on this domain

channels.label: KuCoin Information Request System (law enforcement)
channels.notes: Sign up or log in as an LE agency, pass the identity review, then submit. Authorised law-enforcement officials with proof of authority only. Aegis never registers or submits there: the officer does, with the pack.

channels.label: KuCoin EU law-enforcement inbox
channels.notes: An address on the kucoin.eu domain, for competent law-enforcement authorities after confirming the person is an existing KuCoin EU customer. Not catalogued until reviewed.

channels.label: KuCoin support ticket (Submit a Ticket)
channels.notes: KuCoin's general support ticket form, linked from every support page. Whether a non-user can file without an account is not stated.

kucoin.le.notes: KuCoin's LE channel is its Information Request System (kucoin.request_system); KuCoin EU: kucoin.eu_le.

instrument.notes: A police case number is effectively needed for any action (reported).

deadlines.action: KuCoin's temporary restraint after a private report lasts 7 days: LE sends a signed or sealed document or freezing order through the Request System before it lapses, or the account is unfrozen.

paths.notes: KuCoin reportedly told a project it needed a formal law-enforcement case number before freezing. It has also described proactive 'temporary restraining measures' (its own X post, found through search: x.com refuses fetches): a temporary hold of 7 days, never a legal freeze, lifted unless law enforcement sends a duly signed or sealed document or freezing order through the Request System before then. Get the officer's request in quickly.

instrument.notes: An official request such as a subpoena, court order, warrant or equivalent, signed or sealed; a digital signature / seal is not accepted (a scanned signed copy may do). Documents and e-mails in English.

deadlines.action: Without a stated freeze duration KuCoin unfreezes the account within 30 days of the freeze: state the duration, or extend / serve a court order before then.

paths.notes: Proof of authority: photo evidence of the officer's authority, proof of authorisation and current position, a government-domain e-mail. Unless the request says otherwise, KuCoin tells the user the reason for a freeze: include a non-disclosure statement. Mark 'URGENT REQUEST' in the subject.

instrument.notes: Subpoena, court order, warrant or equivalent, signed or sealed.

paths.notes: Case by case; the data categories are not listed.

instrument.notes: Attach the Mutual Legal Assistance Treaty documents when cross-border law enforcement is involved.

paths.notes: The guidelines name no issuing jurisdiction: when the agency's own request is refused as cross-border, add the MLAT bundle.

instrument.notes: The requesting authority and, where available, a subpoena, court order, warrant or equivalent; a freeze states its reason with supporting documents. Handled under EU and national law.

paths.notes: First confirm the person is an existing KuCoin EU customer. Data is disclosed only to a competent authority and limited to what is needed. No response deadline; 'prompt processing' for freezes.

reply_signals.phrase: within 30 days from the date of the freeze
